h1: Packaging Mockup Generator for Shelf and Scene Previews
lead: See your pouch, box or bottle artwork in a shelf or cafe scene before you pay for a print run. Upload one photo of the package and get a square preview.

steps.d: Add one clear photo of the pouch, box or bottle you will ship. The shape in your photo stays the shape in the preview.

steps_h2: How to Make a Packaging Mockup in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: One package photo becomes a styled scene preview - no studio, no print order, no wait.

faq.q: Can I make a packaging mockup from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. A clear photo of the pouch, box or bottle can become a square scene preview. The credit cost appears before the job runs.

faq.q: Which package shapes work for a mockup?
faq.a: Pouches, cartons, bottles, tins, jars and bags work when the package shape is visible in the source photo.

faq.q: Can a mockup verify my printed colors?
faq.a: No. It shows presentation and composition. A printer proof or press sample remains the authority for color, ink and small legal text.

faq.q: Will small label text come out clearly?
faq.a: Dense ingredient panels and other fine print can blur or change. Use a photo of the real pack for exact wording.

faq.q: Can I compare two packaging variants?
faq.a: Yes. Create both variants in the same scene and compare the front panel, outline and shelf setting side by side.

faq.q: Can I use the mockup as my listing photo?
faq.a: Use it for a setting or launch concept. Keep a clear photo of the real package for measurements and details buyers must verify.

faq.q: What does a packaging preview cost?
faq.a: Each square packaging mockup costs 24 credits. The total appears before the job runs, and failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: Can I share the preview with clients or retailers?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded files have no watermark and can support a retailer deck or pitch before print production.
